name: Celtic Knot Design
instruction: Design a 3D model of a Celtic knot. The knot should be intricate, with interlocking loops and a continuous pattern. Ensure the design is symmetrical and has a traditional Celtic feel.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a Celtic knot.
The knot features intricate interlocking loops.
The design showcases a continuous pattern.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The loops are proportionate to each other.
The overall dimensions maintain a balanced appearance.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The loops interlock correctly without overlapping incorrectly.
The design maintains a three-dimensional quality, with depth in the loops.
The symmetry is preserved from all angles.
Object distance and contact: The loops connect seamlessly without gaps.
There is a clear distinction between each loop while maintaining continuity.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes of the Celtic knot are accurately represented.
The design adheres to the requirement of being intricate and symmetrical.
The traditional Celtic feel is effectively captured.
